title: nematanthus selloanus
intro: Nematanthus selloanus, commonly known as Goldfish Plant or Sello's Nematanthus, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Gesneriaceae family. The health benefits of Nematanthus selloanus are largely attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds. Research has identified the presence of bioactive constituents like sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids in Nematanthus selloanus, contributing to its medicinal properties.
